definitions.gloss: patiently; taking one's time; without rushing
definitions.explanation: Doing something at a relaxed pace without hurrying or becoming frustrated. Implies a calm, unhurried approach.

examples.japanese: {気長|きなが}に⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}ちましょう→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: Let's wait patiently for a reply.

examples.japanese: ⟦{語学|ごがく}→語学：02770_gogaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上達|じょうたつ}→上達：03346_joutatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{気長|きなが}に⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧だ。
examples.english: Improving at a language takes time, so it's important to keep at it patiently.

notes:
USAGE:
{気長|きなが}に is most commonly followed by ⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to wait). The base form ⟦{気長|きなが}→気長：20721_kinaga⟧ can also be used as a na-adjective meaning patient or easygoing: {気長|きなが}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a patient person), {気長|きなが}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (an easygoing personality).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気長|きなが}に⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to wait patiently)
- {気長|きなが}に⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to continue patiently)
- {気長|きなが}に⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}う→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧ (to deal with something patiently)
- {気長|きなが}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a patient person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{気短|きみじか} is the antonym, meaning short-tempered or impatient: {気短|きみじか}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (an impatient person).
